# TrewSync

> Self-hosted Obsidian sync with full version history and a built-in agent endpoint, on a server you run.

TrewSync syncs notes and attachments through a server the user controls. The
server holds notes and their history in plaintext; there is no end-to-end
encryption. With `-mcp` it also serves an MCP endpoint at `/mcp`, where an
agent holding a token reads the whole vault and, with a write token, makes
exact, recorded, undoable edits; what the agent reads reaches its model
provider. The supported client environment is macOS, Linux, and Android with
local storage; Android sync runs in the foreground. The CLI is experimental.
Settings and plugins do not sync.

For installation requests, start with the agent runbook. Follow linked references
only as needed. The URLs below point to Markdown on the main branch; use matching
release documentation and release notes when installed behavior differs.

## Install and use

- [Agent installation runbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/llm.md): Set up the server, secure connection, plugin, pairing, verification, and optionally the agent endpoint.
- [Server setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/docs/server.md): Docker, binaries, TLS, and upgrades.
- [Obsidian plugin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/docs/plugin.md): Pairing, status, history, undo, and recovery.
- [Connect an agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/docs/agent.md): The MCP endpoint, tokens and scopes, the tools, writing safely, undo, and the untrusted-content envelope.
- [Command-line client](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/docs/client.md): Optional headless mirror and automation.
- [Security and privacy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/docs/security.md): What the server reads, devices and invites, agent tokens, revocation, and backups.
- [Server maintenance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/docs/server-operations.md): Backup, restore, repair, and purge.

## Reference

- [Server command reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/docs/server-reference.md): Flags, limits, audit, undo, and health checks.
- [CLI reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/docs/cli-reference.md): Commands, flags, and outcomes.

## Optional

- [Product comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/docs/compared.md): Which sync option fits the user's needs.
- [Design and threat model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/docs/design.md): Durability rules, conflicts, folders, and the agent endpoint's principles.
- [Developer documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/docs/development.md): Protocol, measurements, and review history.
